description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa near centre of plan facing the dining/living area; armchair near the front room facing inward. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is living area, straight corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Master suite (en-suite bathroom) — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Master suite (en-suite bathroom) at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: large families; households needing multiple bedrooms; those requiring a dedicated home office or desk space; wheelchair users due to narrow elongated layout and tight corridor.
